'''Raalo''' was a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]]. He was highly adept at making repairs and modifications to [[Droid/Legends|droids]], though he was more interested in the business side of his operation.<ref name="SGtD" />
